name: Barada
text: The Barada (Arabic: بَرَدَىٰ / ALA-LC: Baradā) is the main river of Damascus, the capital city of Syria.

depictions.name: Barada
depictions.text: The Barada is the main river in Damascus, Syria. Flowing from the northern end of the city's poor district to the western end of the rich district, it gave the city a distinctive appearance. Moreover, the river creates a huge oasis called Ghouta outside of the city walls.
